echoParts: to enter the Most Holy Place
verseText: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus.
meaning: Because of what Jesus did for us on the cross, we don't need a temple to meet with God. We can pray directly to Him anytime.

recall.question: What gives us confidence to come near to God?

meaning.question: In the Old Testament, only the high priest could enter the Most Holy Place. Why can we now come near to God with confidence?
choices: God doesn't meet with his people

application.prompt: Because Jesus died for our sins, we don't need a special building to help us talk to God. We can come to Him in prayer anytime! The next time you're worried, afraid, or need help, remember that Jesus has opened the way for you to come to God wherever you are!
